newsitem.title: USA: Diamond Multimedia sees Q1 oper loss.
newsitem.headline: Diamond Multimedia sees Q1 oper loss.

text.p: Diamond Multimedia Systems Inc said Wednesday it expects to post a first quarter operating loss of between $0.12 a share and $0.18 a share on revenues of about $112 million.

Analysts had expected Diamond Multimedia would earn $0.14 a share in the first quarter, according to First Call. In the year-ago period the company had revenue of $188 million and net income of $11.2 million, or $0.32 a share.
The company said in a statement the weaker than expected results for the quarter, ended March 30, were due to lower gross margins than in the previous quarter.

The company said in a statement revenues were lower becasue of lower than expected demand in the high end of the mainstream graphics market, the transition from 33.6kbps to 56kbps modems, lower product demand in Europe, Korea and Japan, and price declines in both the modem and the graphics markets.
Margins were hurt by the lower volumes for the quarter and by price protection resulting from aggressive channel pricing, the company said.
